accountLocked.subject: {system}: Sign-in temporarily locked
accountLocked.text:
Hello {name},

there were a lot of failed sign-in attempts for your account in a short time. Sign-in is therefore locked for everyone for about {minutes} minutes.

If this wasn't you, please change your password once the lock has expired, turn on two-factor authentication and contact the administrators.

resetPassword.subject: {system}: Reset your password
resetPassword.text:
Hello {name},

you can reset your password using the following link (valid for 1 hour):
{url}

If you didn't request this, simply ignore this message.

verifyAccount.subject: {system}: Confirm your email address
verifyAccount.text:
Hello {name},

please confirm your email address using the following link (valid for 1 hour). You can only sign in after that:
{url}

If you didn't create an account, ignore this message.

verifyNewEmail.subject: {system}: Confirm your new email address
verifyNewEmail.text:
Hello {name},

please use the following link to confirm that this address should be used for your account from now on (valid for 1 hour). You need to be signed in in this browser:
{url}

If you didn't request this, ignore this message.

emailChangeRequested.subject: {system}: Change of your email address requested
emailChangeRequested.text:
Hello {name},

a change of your account's email address to {email} was requested. The change only takes effect once the link in the confirmation email sent to the new address is opened.

If this wasn't you, please change your password immediately and contact the administrators.

emailChangedByAdmin.subject: {system}: The email address of your account was changed
emailChangedByAdmin.text:
Hello {name},

the administrators changed the email address of your account to {email}. From now on all messages, including password reset links, go to this address. All previous sessions have been ended.

If this change wasn't agreed with you, please contact the administrators right away.

invite.subject: {system}: Invitation
invite.text:
Hello {name},

an account has been created for you at {system}. Use the following link to set your password (valid for {days} days):
{url}

Afterwards, sign in with your email address.

impersonated.subject: {system}: An administrator is acting in your account
impersonated.text:
Hello {name},

{admin} (administration) is acting in your account for a short time (for example to reproduce a problem). Every step is logged.

If you did not expect this, please contact the administration.
